Frequently Asked Questions

What is the best order to organize a refrigerator during a January reset?

Empty one shelf at a time, wipe it down, group items by category (drinks, breakfast, condiments, produce), and place clear bins by expiration priority so older items stay in front.

Should you decant every dry food item in a small pantry?

Focus on staples you buy repeatedly (flour, sugar, oats, rice, pasta, coffee) and keep boxed snacks in open clear bins so restocking stays fast.
